subcategory_text: Data elements within the data actions are inventoried.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CM-8(1) (Updates During System Component Installation/Removal)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.AM-07 (data and metadata inventory)
implementation_examples: Maintain a data-element inventory that lists the specific data elements captured and processed for each data action
Classify data elements by sensitivity (standard identifier, sensitive attribute, special category)
Align data elements with the records-of-processing register so privacy-impact assessments can reason over element-level risk
assessment_objectives: Determine whether a complete data-element inventory exists
Determine whether data elements are sensitivity-classified
Determine whether the data-element inventory is reconciled with the records-of-processing register
Determine whether data-element changes are versioned and auditable
